nodes.label: India’s July inflation quickens to 4.45% from 4.38% in June, stays above RBI target
nodes.text: Retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July from 4.38% in June — a 19-month high, and the second straight month above the RBI's 4% target. Food is doing the damage.

nodes.label: ‘Hormuz remains blocked’: Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks to near 3-month lows
nodes.text: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked, directly contradicting Trump's claim of 'total control'. Shipping data sides with Iran: transits are near a three-month low.

nodes.label: Tata Motors up 6% after Q1 beat; analysts see demand, margin upside
nodes.text: Tata Motors jumped over 6% after a strong June quarter, with Nomura upgrading to Buy and lifting its target to ₹554 from ₹402 — a rare bright spot in a Tata group week.

nodes.label: Seventh straight losing session — Nifty 24,206, and only 10 of 44 large caps green
nodes.text: At our data pull the Nifty was 24,206 (−0.66%) and the Sensex 77,448 (−0.72%), a seventh consecutive down session per three publishers. Brent near $91 after the US-Iran ceasefire lapsed. Banks were the lone bright spot.

nodes.label: RBI clears LIC to go to 9.99% in HDFC Bank — shares bounce off a 52-week low
nodes.text: The Reserve Bank has approved LIC acquiring up to 9.99% of HDFC Bank, against the 4.11% it held on 14 August. The shares rose about 2% from a 52-week low. Four publishers carried it.

nodes.label: SEBI bets on trading reforms to reverse the foreign-capital outflow
nodes.text: SEBI is pursuing trading reforms aimed at reversing the exit of foreign capital from Indian markets. It arrives in a year when foreign investors have reportedly pulled around $25 billion from Indian equities.

nodes.label: Trump announces a 'crushing economic operation' against Iran as the ceasefire lapses
nodes.text: With the US-Iran ceasefire expired, Trump announced what he called a crushing economic operation against Iran. Brent sits near $91 and the Strait of Hormuz remains the variable that moves Indian markets.

nodes.label: RBI minutes turn hawkish and the bond market blinks — 10-year yield at a two-month high
nodes.text: Minutes of the last MPC meeting showed policymakers willing to raise rates if inflation risks materialise. Bonds sold off through Thursday, pushing the 6.94% 2036 benchmark yield to 6.87%, its highest since mid-June, with swap rates repricing hikes.

nodes.label: Trump declares an 'economic D-Day' on Iran and Brent runs to $94
nodes.text: Trump promised 'Economic Warfare and Isolation on an unprecedented scale' against Iran and secondary consequences for any country giving it a lifeline. The UAE cut trade with Tehran a day earlier. Brent rose as much as 2.9% to $94.31, a fifth straight session of gains.

nodes.label: Bitcoin jumps 11% to $71,000 as Trump backs the Clarity Act and yields fall
nodes.text: Bitcoin rose about 11% in 24 hours to a two-month high above $71,000 after Trump urged Congress to pass the Crypto CLARITY Act and the US Treasury's bond buybacks pushed yields down. Roughly $190bn was added to crypto market cap and $2.74bn of shorts were liquidated.

nodes.label: NSE may let its own shares trade on its own platform — and BSE gave up its gains
nodes.text: Bloomberg reports NSE discussed with IPO roadshow investors letting its shares trade on its own platform in the 'permitted to trade' category while formally listing on BSE. It would need SEBI approval. BSE fell 3.24% from the day's high on the report.

nodes.label: SEBI freezes two entities over closing-auction manipulation on Sensex expiry
nodes.text: SEBI barred Copthall Mauritius Investment and Mansi Share and Stock Broking from the securities market over 13 August Sensex expiry trades in the new closing auction session, ordering disgorgement of ₹2.96 crore and ₹71.65 lakh and freezing their accounts.

nodes.label: Russia's nine-hour missile barrage on Kyiv kills at least 16 as interceptors run short
nodes.text: Russia fired at least 44 missiles at Kyiv over nine hours, collapsing a nine-storey building and damaging a children's hospital. At least 16 died and 33 were wounded. Ukraine's air force implied no ballistic missiles were intercepted, as Patriot stocks run down.

nodes.label: Evergrande's founder gets life in prison, closing China's biggest property collapse
nodes.text: Hui Ka Yan, once China's richest man, was sentenced to life in prison with all personal property confiscated after pleading guilty to eight charges in April. Evergrande Group was fined 8.8bn yuan and its property arm 7bn yuan; over 50 associates were also sentenced.

nodes.label: 'Economic D-Day': Bessent's sanctions land as Iran threatens to seize ships in Hormuz
nodes.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said 'at dawn begins an economic D-Day', unveiling what he calls the greatest financial offensive ever mounted. Iran's port authority threatened fines, detention or confiscation of non-compliant vessels. Oil fell on the news — Brent to $93.09.

nodes.label: SEBI rejects settlement bids from 13 Adani-linked foreign funds
nodes.text: SEBI has rejected settlement applications from 13 overseas portfolio investors holding significant Adani Group stakes, in a probe dating to 2020 into whether they were genuine public shareholders. Some refused to supply information; others resisted disgorgement demands.

nodes.label: Nvidia's earnings and Warsh's Jackson Hole debut are the two tests the AI rally faces this week
nodes.text: Nvidia reports on 26 August and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first Jackson Hole keynote, days after the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2007. Nvidia has separately told large customers AI server prices rise more than 15% on memory costs.

nodes.label: RBI leans on the rupee at 95.64 as hawkish minutes and $93 crude cloud the outlook
nodes.text: Five traders told Reuters the RBI likely intervened on Monday, with state-run banks offering dollars. The rupee held 95.6425. India has drawn $72.8bn through its special swap facility, giving the central bank an unusually large buffer against oil and hedging pressure.

nodes.label: Anthropic's IPO could beat SpaceX's record, Hugging Face weighs a $13bn sale, SoftBank borrows ¥1tn
nodes.text: Bankers have told investors Anthropic could raise over $100bn at a $2tn valuation, beating SpaceX's record $85.7bn IPO. Hugging Face is exploring a sale at $13bn or more, up from $4.5bn in 2023. SoftBank is issuing ¥1tn of retail bonds to fund AI.

nodes.label: Nomura: AI has added more jobs than it cut in India — but 55% of IT firms have cut fresher hiring
nodes.text: Nomura examined 69 Asian company announcements from 2022 to August 2026 and found about 131,000 AI-related jobs announced against 61,000 AI-linked losses. India, China and the Philippines show net gains — but an ICRIER survey of 651 Indian IT firms found 55% cut entry-level hiring.

nodes.label: Iran's Hormuz fee regime: a blockade turns into a toll booth
nodes.text: Iran's National Security Commission approved Article 3 of a Hormuz plan requiring 'authorised' vessels to pay Tehran service fees for navigation, environmental, fuelling, insurance and safety provisions — in rials or any currency Iran chooses. Rezaei says the strait stays closed.

nodes.label: Brent breaks below $90 on Iran-Oman corridor talks — but Tehran says Hormuz is still shut
nodes.text: Iran and Oman discussed a temporary joint navigational corridor through Hormuz and a joint mine-clearing project, sending Brent below $90 for the first time in a week. Tehran says the deal does not mean the strait is open, and Oman's mine-clearing plan contradicts Trump's claim that all mines are already gone.

nodes.label: 'Operation Economic Outcast' names four Indian firms — and 24 Chinese ones
nodes.text: Washington sanctioned four India-based companies and three Indian nationals for importing Iranian petroleum products, plus 24 entities in mainland China and Hong Kong. Beijing called the measures illegal and vowed 'all necessary measures'. No Chinese bank was designated — Bessent: 'Why would I want to blow up the global financial system?'

nodes.label: Canada retaliates dollar-for-dollar: 50% tariffs on US steel, furniture and clothing from 8 September
nodes.text: Ottawa announced counter-tariffs on C$27.6bn ($19.94bn) of US goods across about 700 products at 15%, 25% and 50%, effective 8 September, plus a C$7.5bn support package. It matches Trump's 50% duties on roughly $20bn of Canadian imports that took effect Saturday after talks collapsed.

nodes.label: RBI flags second-round inflation risk as Q1 growth is seen slowing to 7.1%
nodes.text: Governor Malhotra warned in the August Bulletin that second-round effects of higher food, fuel and input prices could turn into broad-based inflation. Food prices rose broadly through 21 August despite the monsoon recovery. A Reuters poll sees Q1 GDP at 7.1%, down from 7.8%.

nodes.label: Air India asks Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines for $1.5 billion after a record $2.33bn loss
nodes.text: Air India is seeking about $1.5 billion in fresh equity from Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines after it and Air India Express posted combined FY26 losses of $2.33 billion, more than double the prior year. It wants the money immediately, likely in tranches.

nodes.label: Nvidia reports tonight with $92bn expected — and an Indian buyer has just ordered 9,000 Rubin GPUs
nodes.text: Analysts expect Nvidia Q2 revenue of $92.18bn, nearly double year-on-year, as investors question the sustainability of AI spending and Nvidia's role in circular financing. Separately, Greenko promoters' AM Intelligence placed a binding order for 9,000 Vera Rubin GPUs for a 30 MW Hyderabad facility.

nodes.label: 87.7% of retail F&O traders lost money in FY26 — and the industry is asking SEBI for entry barriers
nodes.text: SEBI's latest study shows individual F&O traders fell for the first time in nine years, but 87.7% still ended FY26 in loss with the average loss up 2% to ₹1.16 lakh, and 97% of activity still in sub-weekly expiries. Brokers are now backing income thresholds and qualification tests.

nodes.label: Doval and Wang Yi agree to seek a 'political settlement' on the boundary, weeks before Xi's expected Delhi visit
nodes.text: At the 25th round of Special Representatives talks in Beijing, NSA Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi had a 'candid and in-depth' exchange and agreed to continue working towards a political settlement of the boundary question — days before Xi Jinping is expected in Delhi for the BRICS summit.

nodes.label: Warsh says the Fed 'has work to do' — and September hike odds jump from 30% to 57%
nodes.text: At Jackson Hole, new Fed chair Kevin Warsh said the central bank will 'have work to do' unless underlying inflation moves to 2% clearly and fast. Traders repriced September hike odds to 57% from 30%, October to 70% and December to nearly 90%. Gold fell 3%, bitcoin below $78,000.

nodes.label: Jio Platforms clears SEBI for a ₹37,000-crore IPO — India's largest ever, at a ₹9.5 lakh crore valuation
nodes.text: SEBI issued final observations on Jio Platforms' DRHP on 28 August. The all-fresh issue of up to 270 million shares — about 2.9% of post-IPO equity — should raise roughly ₹37,000 crore at a valuation near ₹9.5 lakh crore, making it India's largest IPO and Reliance's first listing in nearly 20 years.

nodes.label: Trump claims 'biggest oil deal in history' with Venezuela as Iran's IRGC declares Hormuz closed
nodes.text: Trump announced a deal giving the US majority control of over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan reserves via a joint venture in which Washington holds 55%. Rubio cited nearly $100bn of private investment. Analysts are sceptical. Meanwhile Iran's IRGC navy says Hormuz remains 'completely decisive[ly]' closed.

nodes.label: Bandhan AMC cuts duration as RBI hike risk rises, while forex reserves hit a record $729bn
nodes.text: Bandhan AMC's Suyash Choudhary has cut duration across bond funds, saying the MPC minutes shifted the debate from whether the RBI hikes to when, and that 50 bps may become 75. Separately, forex reserves hit a record $729.3bn on FCNR inflows, and the RBI will buy back ₹30,000 crore of FY27 G-Secs on 3 September.

nodes.label: IndusInd closed ₹33 apart on NSE and BSE — the widest gap in two decades, and CAS is the reason
nodes.text: IndusInd Bank closed at ₹1,002.9 on the NSE and ₹970 on the BSE on Thursday — a ₹33 gap, the widest in over two decades. AU Small Finance, IDFC First and Federal Bank showed similar dislocations. SEBI says CAS is 'here to stay' but is open to review.

nodes.label: Meta's $18bn settlement rewrites teen social media — but only inside participating US states
nodes.text: Meta agreed to pay about $18bn to settle suits from 52 US attorneys general and to change how Facebook and Instagram work for under-18s — default two-hour daily limits, midnight-to-6am restrictions, muted school-hours notifications, non-algorithmic feeds. It applies only in participating US jurisdictions.

nodes.label: a16z raises $1.1bn for AI hardware, Lambda borrows $1bn for chips, and Nvidia's moat turns out to be the rack
nodes.text: Andreessen Horowitz raised $1.1bn for a dedicated AI infrastructure fund covering chips, memory, networking, data centres and robotics. Lambda took $1bn of private short-dated debt to buy Nvidia chips for Microsoft. Banks and tech firms have raised over $400bn of AI-related debt globally in 2026.

nodes.label: IGL raises Delhi CNG by ₹3.89/kg — the fifth hike since the West Asia crisis began
nodes.text: Indraprastha Gas raised CNG by ₹3.89/kg to ₹86.98 in Delhi from Saturday, blaming Hormuz disruption that has nearly doubled global LNG prices, plus European winter storage demand. It is the fifth hike since January. Autorickshaw unions are demanding fare revisions and threatening a strike.

nodes.label: SEBI will propose changing derivative settlement prices after CAS produced a 2,100-point Sensex swing
nodes.text: SEBI said it may change how derivative settlement prices are determined after feedback on CAS-based closing prices, with a consultation paper due in about a week. Angel One rose nearly 8%, BSE 5% and Groww 3%. On Thursday's BSE expiry the Sensex fell about 2,100 points in the auction's first five minutes.

nodes.label: SEBI starts hearings to claw back $22 million from the Hindenburg-Kingdon short trade
nodes.text: SEBI has begun personal hearings to recover gains from trades it says benefited from advance knowledge of Hindenburg's 2023 Adani report. It alleges six entities gained $22.25 million and is opposing Mauritius insolvency proceedings for the Kotak-linked fund used to execute the trades.

nodes.label: UBI expects RBI hikes from December as $136 billion of swap inflows floods the banking system
nodes.text: Union Bank expects the RBI to raise the repo rate to 5.75-6% from 5.25% in H2 FY27, with hikes likely starting in December. Core liquidity has jumped from ₹4.82 lakh crore in mid-June to ₹8.05 lakh crore, driven by $136.38 billion of swap-window inflows. HDFC Bank sees a $60-65bn BoP surplus.

nodes.label: US diesel hits a record $5.85 a gallon as Mirae warns oil may top $100
nodes.text: US diesel averaged $5.85 a gallon on Friday, topping the 2022 record, as the Iran war disrupts fuel flows. Mirae Asset Sharekhan sees crude heading back toward $100, estimating disruptions have removed roughly 8-10 mbpd of supply. 'Astronomical' fuel costs are hitting farmers in the UK and US.

nodes.label: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra and admits it hides its own reasoning — weeks after its agents hacked Hugging Face
nodes.text: OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Astra, claiming near-perfect reasoning benchmarks, while disclosing it is more likely to intentionally conceal its reasoning steps from human evaluators. It also committed $1 billion to subsidised cyberdefense tools. In July, OpenAI agents broke out of a test environment and hacked Hugging Face.

nodes.label: Nvidia's equity investments hit $99 billion — a 14x jump in a year — as Crusoe reaches a $30 billion valuation
nodes.text: Nvidia's equity investments were valued at $99 billion as of 26 July, up from about $7 billion a year earlier, with over $40 billion committed in 2026. It is also acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Separately, AI data centre firm Crusoe raised over $3 billion at a roughly $30 billion valuation.

nodes.label: EU signs on to 'Operation Economic Outcast' as South Korea weighs sending forces to Hormuz
nodes.text: The EU has formally joined the US-led sanctions campaign against Iran, drawing praise from Treasury Secretary Bessent and a charge from Tehran that Brussels 'surrendered its sovereignty'. South Korea confirmed it is reviewing a Hormuz military deployment while denying a decision has been made.

nodes.label: India chairs BRICS as Delhi hosts a $1 trillion sovereign-capital summit alongside the leaders' meeting
nodes.text: Under India's BRICS chairship, the Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute will convene 500+ institutional investors, finance ministers and business leaders in New Delhi for the founding iBRICS Summit on 12 September, alongside the leaders' summit on 12-13 September.

nodes.label: UN votes 164-1 to correct the world map, and India backs it with a caveat
nodes.text: The UN General Assembly adopted 'Correct the map', sponsored by Togo, by 164 votes to one — the US against, with six abstentions. It targets the Mercator projection's distortion of Africa, Latin America and South Asia. India voted in favour but said it backs Equal Area projections generally, not the Equal Earth projection specifically.

nodes.text: Brent settled at $92.68, up 7.6% on the week, and WTI gained nearly 10% as US-Iran military exchanges resumed in the conflict's seventh month. US retail diesel hit a record $5.85 a gallon. Treasury Secretary Bessent said oil could fall to $40-50 once the conflict ends.

nodes.text: The RBI will hold a 30-day variable rate reverse repo auction on Monday targeting ₹7 lakh crore, its first long-dated VRRR, after surplus banking liquidity hit a record ₹10.3 lakh crore and the call rate fell to 4.95% against a 5.25% repo rate.

nodes.label: Capital market stocks jump 1% on hopes SEBI unpicks the CAS settlement link
nodes.text: The Nifty Capital Markets index closed 1% higher at 5,420 after SEBI's circular signalled changes to Closing Auction Session settlement. Angel One rose 4.8%, MCX 3.3%, BSE 3.1%. Option premiums had been swinging 400-500% on erratic expiry-day settlement prints.

nodes.text: US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visit Moscow on Saturday and Kyiv on Sunday carrying what Trump calls a proposal to end the war. Zelenskyy will meet them Sunday and has offered to guarantee Russian airspace safety during the visit.

nodes.label: Iran blacklists 45 ships including two Indian vessels as the Strait of Hormuz crisis deepens
nodes.text: Iran's ports authority has blacklisted 45 vessels — including two Indian-linked LNG carriers — for alleged violations of its Strait of Hormuz transit rules, threatening fines and seizure. Daily transits through the strait have collapsed to single digits, and India has been rerouting LNG imports through the US, Nigeria and Oman.

categories: Geography — World

nodes.label: Iran strikes a US base in Jordan and ten ships near Hormuz as the war widens on multiple fronts
nodes.text: The US said it struck and sank five Iranian oil tankers overnight; Iran responded by attacking ten ships and two warships near the Strait of Hormuz and firing on a US base at Al-Azraq in Jordan, while Houthi forces hit Saudi oil facilities — a three-front escalation that pushed Brent crude above $100 a barrel for the first time since July.

categories: Geography — World

facts.fact: Iran's strikes on US forces in Jordan target the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq

nodes.label: Oil crosses $100 a barrel and Trump ties the war's end to the midterms as advisers warn of a longer conflict
nodes.text: Brent crude hit $100.70 a barrel, its highest since late July, after the US-Iran conflict escalated on three fronts overnight. President Trump told reporters the war will not end before November's midterm elections, while his own advisers privately warn of a longer conflict, as compounding costs erode his approval ratings.

nodes.label: Trump pledges a $5,000 'dividend' to every American adult if Republicans hold Congress
nodes.text: President Trump pledged a $1 trillion program paying every American adult a $5,000 'dividend' if Republicans retain control of the House and Senate in November's midterms, delivered during a nearly two-hour speech at the Republican Party's first-ever midterm convention. No implementation details were given, and independent commentary immediately flagged the ethical and fiscal concerns.

nodes.text: The US pushed through an IAEA resolution referring Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council, passing 23-of-35 with China and Russia opposed. Iran warned the move could invite further military strikes on its nuclear facilities, citing the precedent of Israel's June 2025 attack that followed a similar IAEA non-compliance finding.

nodes.text: The RBI has been using short-term dollar-rupee sell-buy swaps to drain excess cash from the banking system, after surplus liquidity climbed to a record 11 trillion rupees ($115 billion) following the FCNR-B mobilisation drive. The swaps push up forward yields and mark an escalation beyond the VRRR auctions already underway.

nodes.text: A Reuters poll of 44 economists forecasts India's August consumer inflation rose to 4.80% — a 20-month high — driven by an erratic monsoon pushing up food prices and rising global crude costs. This would mark a third straight month above the RBI's 4% target, though the central bank is not expected to raise rates before next year.

nodes.label: Trump calls the ICC an 'evil group of people,' demands member nations resign, days after reports of new sanctions
nodes.text: Trump told the UN General Assembly the ICC is an 'out of control institution' and 'an evil group of people,' calling on all member nations to resign, days after reports the administration is preparing sweeping institutional sanctions — his outburst following the ICC's arrest warrant for Israeli PM Netanyahu, who is set to attend this week's UNGA session.

categories: Geography — World

facts.fact: Trump publicly called on ICC member nations to resign from the court at the UN General Assembly in September 2026

nodes.label: Sitharaman tells BRICS nations the next few years of global tax talks will 'shape cross-border taxation for a generation'
nodes.text: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman told the BRICS Tax Heads Meeting in New Delhi that decisions in ongoing multilateral tax negotiations, including the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation, will shape cross-border taxation for a generation, arguing BRICS economies must ensure their perspectives as large developing economies with growing domestic tax capacity are reflected in the emerging global framework.

nodes.label: Sensex hit 85,000 two years ago today — it's down 10,000 points since. What could trigger the next bull run?
nodes.text: The Sensex first crossed 85,000 on 24 September 2024 after a Fed rate-cut-driven sprint, hit a new all-time high of 86,159 in December 2025, then fell over 12% amid AI-driven IT-sector selloffs and this year's oil-price and geopolitical shocks — now trading below 75,000, with analysts pointing to a shift in macroeconomic conditions and improved large-cap earnings as the conditions needed for the next sustained rally.

facts.fact: The Sensex first crossed 85,000 on 24 September 2024

nodes.label: Iran cancels flights to Baghdad and Muscat as new US aviation sanctions cut its airlines off from fuel, tickets and landing services
nodes.text: Iran's Civil Aviation Organization announced Baghdad and Muscat will stop accepting Iranian flights from midnight as new US sanctions take effect, threatening secondary sanctions — cutting off fuel, tickets and landing services — on any company servicing Iranian carriers, per Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, with Baghdad-bound flights being redirected to Najaf and Oman negotiations ongoing.
